title: 10 Food Myths You Still Believe (Debunked)
description:
Think you know the truth about food? Chances are you’ve been carrying around some common food myths your whole life! In this video we bust the top 10 misconceptions about food that science has already debunked. From the myth that spinach is full of iron because of Popeye, to sugar causing hyperactivity in kids, milk producing mucus, and the belief that organic food is always healthier, we explore the facts behind what you eat.

We’ll also clear up popular myths about MSG and “Chinese Restaurant Syndrome”, whether alcohol makes you warmer, if you really need 8 glasses of water daily, and why gluten isn’t bad for everyone. Detox diets? Just marketing hype — your liver already does that for you.

If you’ve searched for food myths debunked, common misconceptions about food, spinach iron myth, detox diets science, MSG truth, gluten free fad, organic food facts, this video will give you the clear, rational perspective.

Food is surrounded by superstitions, false health claims, and marketing tricks, but science gives us the tools to separate fact from fiction. If you want to stop falling for food fads and learn the truth, watch till the end — and don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share to spread the knowledge!

#FoodMyths #ScienceExplained #MythBusting #HealthyEating
